description: The chart illustrates the distribution of reasons for factual errors across four different language models: GPT4-o, Gemini1.5-Pro, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct. Each chart contains five slices representing different error categories. For GPT4-o, the slices are labeled “Safety” (light red, 16.7%), “Lack of Knowledge” (dark red, 83.3%), “Lack of Knowledge” (light red, 16.7%), and “Safety” (light red, 9.3%). For Gemini1.5-Pro, the slices are labeled “Safety” (light red, 9.3%), “Lack of Knowledge” (dark red, 22.1%), “Misinformation” (dark red, 38.4%), “Ethical Advice” (light blue, 16.3%), and “Clarification” (light blue, 14.0%). For Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, the slices are labeled “Clarification” (light blue, 1.25%), “Lack of Knowledge” (dark red, 75.0%), and “Lack of Knowledge” (dark red, 75.0%). Finally, for Llama3.1-405B-Instruct, the slices are labeled “Misinformation” (dark red, 50.0%), and “Lack of Knowledge” (dark red, 50.0%). Each chart includes a legend identifying the error categories and their corresponding colors. Percentage labels are displayed within each slice. The slices in each chart do not appear to be ordered in any particular way.
